tasks.prompt: What is the article's central concern?
options: Social-media systems may wrongly restrict women's health content and reduce access to useful information.
Health charities have stopped using diagrams in all publications.
Meta has banned every advert that mentions a medical product.
Most creators want platforms to remove more educational posts.
tasks.correct_answer: Social-media systems may wrongly restrict women's health content and reduce access to useful information.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת טענות שתוכן בריאות נשים מוגבל, מטושטש או מוסתר בטעות, וכך מידע רפואי חשוב אינו מגיע לקהל.

tasks.prompt: What did Irene Breen say her company had to remove from its website?
options: All photographs of its pillows
The word “pregnancy” from product names and URLs
Every customer review written in 2024
Prices for products sold outside the UK
tasks.correct_answer: The word “pregnancy” from product names and URLs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברין סיפרה שהחברה נאלצה למחוק את המילה pregnancy מכל האתר, משם המוצר ומכתובות ה־URL.

tasks.prompt: What does “shadowbanning” mean as used in the article?
options: Charging creators to publish health information
Permanently deleting a person's account
Quietly suppressing a post's reach or visibility
Allowing a post to appear only in printed form
tasks.correct_answer: Quietly suppressing a post's reach or visibility
tasks.explanation_hebrew: shadowbanning הוא צמצום שקט של החשיפה או הנראות של תוכן, לעיתים בלי שהיוצר מקבל הסבר ברור.

tasks.prompt: What percentage of nearly 200 respondents in CensHERship's survey said they had experienced restrictions?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בדוח של CensHERship, 96% מכמעט 200 יוצרים, ספקים רפואיים, מותגים, עמותות ומחנכים דיווחו על הגבלה כלשהי.

tasks.prompt: Why can an early AI moderation mistake keep affecting similar posts?
options: The system may store a mistaken decision and repeat the same pattern later.
Creators are legally required to copy every rejected post.
Human reviewers never receive automated flags.
Platforms delete all historical moderation data immediately.
tasks.correct_answer: The system may store a mistaken decision and repeat the same pattern later.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ד״ר קרולינה ארה מזהירה שמערכת אוטומטית עלולה לשמור החלטה שגויה ולחזור עליה בתכנים דומים.

tasks.prompt: What does O'Neill mean when she calls advertising on TikTok “like an obstacle course”?
options: It requires repeated appeals and effort because content is often flagged or removed.
It allows only sports videos to be advertised.
It rewards companies for completing physical challenges.
It automatically approves every women's health advert.
tasks.correct_answer: It requires repeated appeals and effort because content is often flagged or removed.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדימוי obstacle course מתאר תהליך מלא מכשולים: ערעורים, סימון והסרה שגוזלים זמן ומשאבים רבים.

tasks.prompt: What examples does the article give of women's health content being restricted or misclassified?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין דוגמאות קונקרטיות: כרית הריון, האשטג סרטן הנרתיק, תרשים אנטומי מטושטש, וסרטון אנדומטריוזיס שסווג כתוכן פוליטי.
expected_points: Instagram restricted adverts for pregnancy pillows because of the word “pregnancy”.
The hashtag #vaginalcancer did not appear on Instagram.
An Eve Appeal anatomical diagram about vulval cancer was removed and later hidden behind a sensitivity filter.
A video about endometriosis pain was rejected as political or social-issues content.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the explanations offered by campaigners, researchers and platforms for the restrictions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את טענות היוצרים על פגיעה במידע חיוני, את הסבר החוקרים על אלגוריתמים וכללים רחבים, ואת תגובות Meta ו־TikTok על הגבלות, ערעורים ושיפור מערכות.
expected_points: Campaigners say legitimate educational and health content is suppressed, blurred or removed.
Researchers say AI can misdetect posts and broad policies may confuse nudity with sexual activity.
Meta says it allows women's health content but applies restrictions to avoid negative user experiences and is consulting health groups.
TikTok says some posts cannot be promoted to the For You feed, but creators are informed and can appeal.

tasks.prompt: How can content restrictions reinforce shame around women's health?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהיוצרים מצנזרים מונחים ונמנעים מנושאים, שהסתרת מידע רפואי מרמזת שהוא מביש, ושקהל עלול לא לזהות תסמינים או לפנות לרופא.
expected_points: Creators replace direct words with euphemisms, symbols or emojis.
Some avoid women's health topics altogether after repeated restrictions.
Treating anatomy and disease information as offensive can imply that normal health topics are shameful.
Reduced visibility may prevent people from recognising symptoms and asking doctors informed questions.

tasks.prompt: Write a concise recommendation for improving moderation of women's health content.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע כללים מדויקים, בדיקה אנושית וערעור ברור, בדיקת הטיות אלגוריתמיות, ושיתוף פעולה בין צוותי מדיניות, טכנולוגיה וארגוני בריאות.
expected_points: Distinguish clinical or educational anatomy from sexual or graphic content in policy and training.
Provide prompt human review and a clear, usable appeals process.
Audit automated systems for repeated false positives involving women's health terms and images.
Coordinate policy, moderation and technical teams with women's health organisations.
